title: Align JS Naming With Rust DTO And Backbone Terms
description: Implement the breaking naming alignment between compose/js and compose/rs for shared DTO/backbone/conflict concepts. Use compose/rs as the naming authority where concepts actually match. Rename JS exports and direct consumers without compatibility aliases. Expected rename set includes: KitDTO->KitWireDto, KitInteractionDTO->KitInteractionDto, KitStoreWireBackboneConfig->BackboneConfig, KitStoreWireConflictResolution->ConflictResolution, KitStoreWireBackboneStatus->BackboneStatusDto, KitStoreWireKitConflict->KitConflict, DevKitBackbone->DevBackbone, LocalKitBackbone->LocalBackbone, RemoteKitBackbone->RemoteBackbone. Audit whether any store/client methods need renaming, but preserve names already aligned with wasm/Rust if no real mismatch exists. Update compose/react imports/re-exports and JS/React AGENTS docs, extend existing embedded tests in compose/js/index.ts to cover the renamed API surface, run relevant JS/react validation, and finish end-to-end.
summary: Aligned compose/js and compose/react public naming with compose/rs by renaming JS DTO/backbone/control-plane types to Rust-aligned terms, removing React compatibility aliases, updating bundle docs, and adding a rename-specific embedded test. Verified exact old identifiers are gone from compose/js and compose/react, compose/react build passes, and the targeted rename smoke test passes. Full compose/js embedded suite still has unrelated pre-existing failures outside the rename scope.
